# Import and tidy up data
```{r import raw data}
# prolific batch 1 + 2 + 3 (n=167)
batch1 <- read_csv("./data/exp-3/00.exp3-raw-batch1.csv")%>%mutate(batch=1)
batch1_attnchecks <- read_csv("./data/exp-3/01.exp3-attnchecks-batch1.csv")%>%mutate(batch=1)

# bind all
data <- rbind(batch1)
attn_checks <- rbind(batch1_attnchecks)
```

```{r apply inclusion criteria}
# set up trial names, create and select relevant columns
L_data <- data%>%
  mutate(data_type="within subjects",
         manipulation_type = case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "1 agent,")==TRUE ~ "baseline",
                                       str_detect(trial_condition, "attention_checks")==TRUE ~ "attention_checks",
                                 TRUE ~ "main"),
         A_intentionality=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "intentional")==TRUE ~ "intentional drop",
                                       str_detect(trial_condition, "no drop")==TRUE ~ "no drop-off",
                                       TRUE ~ "accidental drop"),
         B_intentionality=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "pickup")==TRUE ~ "intend to own",
                                         str_detect(trial_condition, "walkaway")==TRUE ~ "no intent to own",
                                       TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
         B_knowledge=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "aware")==TRUE ~ "knowledgeable",
                                    str_detect(trial_condition, "ignorant")==TRUE ~ "ignorant",
                                    TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
         blue_agent_first=case_when(str_detect(agent_order, "A_2,A_1")==TRUE ~ FALSE,
                                       TRUE ~ TRUE))%>%
  select(unique_id,data_type,batch,trial_condition,manipulation_type,A_intentionality,B_intentionality,B_knowledge,
         blue_agent_first, A1_value, A2_value, stmt_1_response, stmt_2_response,
         stmt_3_response, stmt_4_response, stmt_why_response, object_cost_response,id)

# extract object cost judgments
L_data_object_cost <-L_data%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="attention_checks")%>%
  select(unique_id, object_cost_response)

# add object cost judgments to ownership judgment data
L_data_long <- L_data%>%
  filter(manipulation_type!="attention_checks")%>%
  rename(A=A1_value, B = A2_value)%>%
  gather(agent, value, A,B)%>%
  select(-object_cost_response)%>%
  left_join(L_data_object_cost)%>%
  rename(object_cost = object_cost_response)

L_data_long$object_cost <- as.numeric(L_data_long$object_cost)
L_data_long$value <- as.numeric(L_data_long$value)
L_data_long$agent <- factor(L_data_long$agent, levels=c("A", "B"))

baseline_data<- L_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline" & agent=="B")%>% 
  select(-stmt_why_response, -stmt_1_response,-stmt_2_response,-stmt_3_response,-stmt_4_response)%>%
  spread(agent,value)%>%
  spread(trial_condition,B)

baseline_wide <- baseline_data%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise_all(function(x){x[!is.na(x)]})%>%
  filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop")

strict_baseline_filter_id <- baseline_wide%>%
  filter(`1 agent,accidental`==0 & `1 agent,intentional`==0 & `1 agent,no drop`==0)

strict_baseline_filtered_data_long <- L_data_long%>%
  filter(unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)

# report inclusion rate
nrow(strict_baseline_filter_id)/nrow(attn_checks) # 77.8%
nrow(attn_checks) - nrow(strict_baseline_filter_id) # 37 participants excluded
```

# Report demographics information

# Structure the data for further analyses
```{r prepare dataframe}
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_intentionality <- factor(strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_intentionality,levels = c("Not Applicable", "no intent to own", "intend to own"))
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$A_intentionality <- factor(strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$A_intentionality,levels = c("no drop-off","accidental drop","intentional drop"))
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_knowledge <- factor(strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_knowledge,levels = c("Not Applicable", "knowledgeable","ignorant"))

Main_conditions<-strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="main")%>%
  select(-stmt_why_response, -stmt_1_response,-stmt_2_response,-stmt_3_response,-stmt_4_response)%>%
  spread(agent,value)

Baseline_conditions<-strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline")%>%
  select(-stmt_why_response, -stmt_1_response,-stmt_2_response,-stmt_3_response,-stmt_4_response)%>%
  spread(agent,value)

# write data for quantifying ownership with Exp 4 data (for the written responses)
#write.csv(Main_conditions, "./data/exp-3/02.exp3-main-conditions.csv")
#write.csv(Baseline_conditions, "./data/exp-3/03.exp3-baseline-conditions.csv")
```

```{r get the dataframe ready}
consequences_data_wide <- strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="main")%>%
  filter(agent=="B")%>%
  rename(use=stmt_1_response, dispose=stmt_2_response, alter=stmt_3_response, lend=stmt_4_response)%>%
  select(unique_id, trial_condition, trial_condition,manipulation_type, A_intentionality, B_knowledge, 
         use, dispose, alter, lend, stmt_why_response, agent, value)%>%
  distinct()%>%
  mutate(trial_condition_no = factor(trial_condition))

consequences_data_long <- consequences_data_wide%>%
  select(-stmt_why_response)%>%
  gather(statement_type, statement_response, use, dispose, alter, lend)%>%
  mutate(statement_type = factor(statement_type, levels = c("use", "lend", "alter", "dispose")),
         response_numeric = case_when(statement_response == "Yes" ~ 1, 
                                      TRUE ~ 0),
         statement_response = factor(statement_response, levels=c("No","Yes")))
```

# Ownership consequences analyses
## H1: 
```{r logistic mixed-effects regression: permissibility judgment and B's ownership}
model_consequence_1 <- glmer(response_numeric ~ value + (1+value|statement_type)+(1+value|unique_id), data=consequences_data_long,family=binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

summary(model_consequence_1)

# probability
# https://sebastiansauer.github.io/convert_logit2prob/
exp(model_consequence_1@beta[2])/(exp(model_consequence_1@beta[2])+1) # 0.5467824

# odd ratio
# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/41384075/r-calculate-and-interpret-odds-ratio-in-logistic-regression#:~:text=The%20coefficient%20returned%20by%20a,1%2Bexp(logit))%20. 
exp(model_consequence_1@beta[2]) # 1.206446
```

```{r logistic mixed-effects regression prediction action permissibility with (SI) Table. 22}
tab_model(model_consequence_1, 
          show.ci = F, show.stat = T, show.est = T,
          p.style = "numeric_stars",
          string.stat = "t value", 
          dv.labels = c("Ownership rating"))
```

# Visualization
```{r Figure 4a: median split second agent ownership & permissibility judgments by action}
# median split across conditions
agentB_median_split_data <- consequences_data_long%>%
  mutate(median_split_B = case_when(value<median(value) ~ "less",
                                    TRUE ~ "more"),
         median_split_B = factor(median_split_B, levels=c("less","more")))

agentB_permissibility_byAction <- agentB_median_split_data%>%
  group_by(statement_type,median_split_B) %>%
  tidyboot_mean(column = response_numeric)

agentB_permissibility_byAction%>%
  mutate(median_split_B =factor(median_split_B, levels=c("less","more")))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=statement_type, y = empirical_stat,fill=median_split_B)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",position=position_dodge(.9),color="black", linewidth=.8, width=.8) +
  geom_errorbar (aes(ymin=ci_lower, ymax=ci_upper), linewidth=.7,width=.3,position=position_dodge(.9))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#FFA40060","#FFA400"))+
  geom_hline(yintercept=.5, linetype="dashed", color="darkgrey")+
  ylim(c(0,1))+
  theme_classic()+
  facet_grid(~median_split_B)+
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = .8),
        axis.ticks = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = .8))+
  xlab("Action type")+ylab("Frequency chose 'Yes'")
# saved as 5x5 pdf in landscape
```
